note: Graveborn Bone Archer (unit identity, Graveborn): a gaunt skeleton, biped, bare bone limbs 2 px thick, a bare skull with two dim soul-light pinpricks, a dark moss rag hood slumping back to a point, a moss collar, a ribcage under a torn team jerkin, violet sinew on hems, wrists and ankles, a bone quiver, and a skull on a grave-iron pauldron on the bow shoulder (the mark). Tier I only; no flag on the back.
